exit.textPause: “{{title}}” will be removed from search; you can put it back online later. Why?
exit.deleteNote: A listing with a completed sale or a dispute can’t be deleted.
markSold.title: Sold to whom?
markSold.nobody: Nobody has messaged you about this listing on Dilchap yet.
markSold.offsiteHint: Sold elsewhere, to someone who didn’t message you here
markSold.noteMember: The sale is recorded with this member and the conversation closes; you’ll be able to rate each other. Their hand-over code, if you have it, certifies the sale (optional).
markSold.noteStock: Units sold are removed from stock; the listing stays online while some are left.
markSold.noteSingle: The listing becomes “Sold” and leaves search.
